responsibility: Defines the operand predicates and related helper tests used throughout the rs6000 machine description. It classifies registers, subregs, immediates, addresses, memory forms, TOC and Mach-O references, fusion candidates, PC-relative addresses, and other operand shapes that instruction patterns rely on for matching and reload decisions, making it the central declarative interface between rs6000 RTL patterns and target-specific operand legality logic.
